record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, bound only the exclusive mask embedding with m_eff = m / sqrt(1 + ||m||²), retaining its learnable direction and variable magnitude. The incumbent's raw mask improved validation; a smooth magnitude bound may retain that flexibility while limiting excessive growth. Preserve tied real-item normalization at radius multiplier 0.75, frequency modulation, width, topology, history, loss and optimizer. Apply the identical embedding definition in training and prediction.

category_rationales.rationale: Smoothly bound only the exclusive mask embedding as m / sqrt(1 + ||m||²), preserving its learnable direction and magnitude. Real-item normalization at radius multiplier 0.75, tying, frequency modulation, topology, loss and optimizer remain unchanged. The predictor imports this model definition, so training and inference use identical embeddings with unchanged checkpoint shapes across all four categories.
